The title menu speaks Spanish

Issue #390 · PR #664 by @bluefireF5ran

The cards have spoken Spanish since v0.39.0. Now the menus start to. @bluefireF5ran built a translation layer for the game's own text and translated the title menu with it. Any line that isn't translated yet stays in English, so the game can be translated one screen at a time.

How to switch

  • The menu follows your card language, so the globe button beside the music button and Settings ▸ Card art language switch the text and the card pictures together.
  • The menu redraws in place the moment you switch.
  • On the web, a new player starts in their browser's language. The Spanish downloads start in Spanish.

Still in English

  • Every screen past the title menu, for now.
  • Rank names such as "Sidekick in Training", which come with the Trophy Room later.
  • Next up for translation: the new game flow, then the Settings screens.

Your decks, by name

Issue #658 by @Kravenprime · PR #668

Two Leadership decks of one hero used to look the same on the campaign roster. The hero picker and the seat cards now show the name you saved each deck under, so you can tell them apart.

What changed

  • A built or imported deck shows its name under the hero's, with its aspect and "Built" or "Imported".
  • Only a precon says "starter deck" now. A saved deck with no aspect yet reads "No aspect".
  • The seat card's footer grows to fit, so the names no longer overlap on a short phone.

You asked, we fixed

Issues #643, #654, #660, #663, #665, #675, #678 and #679

Each of these started with a report. Thank you for taking the time to write them up, saves and screenshots included.

#660 · reported by @Kravenprime

A 7 that reads as a 7

The comic number font drew a 7 as a slanted stem under a short bar, so a villain at 7 hit points read as 1. Every 7 in that font now has a crossbar through its stem, in the font's own slant. Nothing else about the font changes.

#665 · reported by @Darksolice

Psychic Misdirection, explained

When Psychic Misdirection sends an attack's damage to an enemy, the defend sheet now says so: the damage goes to that enemy, and defending only takes your DEF off what it takes. The rules worked as written. The sheet made it look like you were the one being protected.

RRG 1.8 "Defend, Defense", p. 15
#678 · reported by @AlecHolland1582

The Power Stone has its stats

The Power Stone now gives its printed +1 ATK and +1 SCH or THW to Nebula and Ronan, and to a hero once it moves to them. Checking every encounter attachment's scan turned up ten more with missing stat boxes, such as Blackjack's Bazooka and Cloak of Hercules, and they're fixed too.

RRG 1.8 "Attachment", p. 8
#679 · reported by @AlecHolland1582

The Market keeps your cart

In The Galaxy's Most Wanted, once every card of a price was bought, the Market still asked for that price with nothing in it. That empty question is gone, and a hero's cart no longer gets lost on the way.

#654 · reported by @andy-xxvii27

Machine Man with an empty hand

Machine Man was offered with nothing to spend and the game got stuck on an empty payment. Now he isn't offered without a resource, and a payment always keeps its Don't use it button.

RRG 1.8 "Cost", pp. 13-14
#663 · reported by @josemarcoshernando-spec

One Shawarma each

Save the Shawarma Place and Defensive Protocols give each player 1 copy, not every copy. Alias Investigations no longer spends its counters on Proxima Midnight or Corvus Glaive while the other still has hit points.

RRG 1.8 "Cannot", p. 11
#643 · suggested by @PermaKarma

One trophy per win

Beating the Black Widow villain with Black Widow seated earns Seeing Double. Clearing the Ledger now needs Taskmaster. If you earned it only from a Black Widow win, it locks again until you beat Taskmaster with her.

#675 · Kang

Pinned Down, as printed

Pinned Down places 2 threat for each obligation in play, as printed, instead of 1.

RRG 1.8 "Side Scheme", p. 40

Found by replaying real games

10 PRs by @bluefireF5ran

@bluefireF5ran kept loading real two-player games from their saves and watching for anything the cards don't allow. Each of these showed up in a game someone actually played.

Wolverine · PR #657

The bug that decided a game

Berserker Barrage defeated one Mutate, and Wolverine repeated it on the other, which has retaliate 1. It retaliated twice. Wolverine fell later that turn on exactly his 10 hit points. The repeat is now its own attack, so the second enemy retaliates once.

Crossbones · PR #651

Your indirect damage

Machine Gun and Full Auto deal their indirect damage to the player who takes it, among their own characters.

RRG 1.8 "You, Your", p. 49
Absorbing Man · Kang · PR #652

Each player chooses

Avalanche! and Corrupted Timestream let each player choose their own option, instead of the player who revealed the card choosing for everyone.

RRG 1.8 "Each Player", p. 17
Black Widow · PR #655

One Widow's Bite is enough

Widow's Bite isn't offered for a minion that already left play, so a second copy isn't spent for nothing after the first defeated it.

RRG 1.8 "Target", p. 42
PR #672

Only while it's there

Hawkeye, Iceman and Prism Dust are offered only while the minion that entered play is still in play.

Black Widow · PR #656

A Preparation that fits

Winter, Widow, Soldier, Spy no longer offers a Max 1 per player Preparation you already control, and still deals its damage when none can enter play.

Nick Fury · PR #662

Respond, then fall

An ally's "after uses a basic power" response resolves before its consequential damage, so it is still offered when that damage defeats it.

RRG 1.8 "Consequential Damage", p. 13
Taunt · PR #671

Defend after all

Another player's defense ability, like Herc's Helm, no longer stops the taunting hero from defending the attack.

Kang · PR #673

Your own obligations

Time-Travel Tactics and Kang (Master of Time) count the obligations in the right player's own play area.

Taskmaster · PR #674

A wild for Moon Knight

Moon Knight's draw-2 Response needs a [wild] resource, as printed, not any resource.

RRG 1.8 "Wild Resource", p. 48

Also in v0.44.0

Rules and docs

Rules

  • An attachment's stat boxes don't count while its identity is in alter-ego form, and count again on the flip back to hero.
  • The SCH/THW attachments in Fear No Evil now count for THW on a hero.

Docs

  • This report, in English and Spanish.
